- Official source: https://yapilol.itch.io/100-assorted-items-16x16-pixel
- Retrieved: 2026-10-04 (Asia/Shanghai).
- Official page's **Asset license** field: **Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal**.

- The full unmodified CC0 legal text is included as `CC0-1.0.txt`, fetched from https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.txt.

The free download button on the official page provided upload `8370029`, original filename `100 assorted items - yapilol.itch.io.7z`. The original 49,583-byte archive is retained as `100-assorted-items-original.7z`. Its SHA256 is `d3ddc97685b5766c964ddecd8086a57110f07f1a300535acd5802d7898949367`. The anonymous download URL is temporary and is not retained.

`icons/` contains 11 unchanged PNG files extracted from the archive's `100 assorted items - yapilol.itch.io/32x32/` directory. These are the creator-provided 32-pixel versions of the 16-pixel icon designs. No resizing, recoloring, pixel replacement, compositing or AI image editing was performed. The archive also contains 16-pixel files; they are not extracted or used here. `SHA256SUMS.txt` records the selected original files and archive.

CC0 permits copying, modification, distribution and commercial use without requiring attribution. Credit is retained here voluntarily. This permission is separate from other character/environment packs in the project.

Runtime mapping in `scripts/art_catalog.gd`: wood → wood, plastic → plastic, scrap → junk parts, rope → rope, stone → rock, ingot → steel, fish → fish, seed → seed, veg → carrot, meal → stew, hammer → hammer. These are original individual PNG textures; there is no vendor sprite sheet to crop. Both `Art.texture()` and `Art.item_icon()` select the same cached texture.

The palm frond, paddle and improvised rope-tied anchor are separate original code-defined 16×16 grids in `art_catalog.gd`, not images from this pack. The existing code-defined ore, equipment, reusable cups and cooked fish remain project artwork. No library or editor installation was required.
